messages:
Tasha (Recruiter): Marina accepted offer for 2026-04-05. She says her EAD renewal was filed 3/20 and biometrics done. Can we enroll her in benefits on day 1 if renewal pending?
Priya - People Ops: We need valid work auth to enroll in medical/401k benefits effective on payroll start. If she starts unpaid orientation we can delay benefit effective date until payroll begins.
Leo (Payroll): To set up benefits we need SSN + valid work auth docs. If we get I-797C receipt now we can prepare the enrollment paperwork but not activate coverage until work auth is verified. Retro coverage start is tricky.
Marina V (New Hire): I uploaded I-797C and passport to the portal just now. Biometrics confirmation included. I have a medical appointment on 4/10; won't want gap in coverage if possible.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Marina V: i797c_32026.pdf :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: Ok we can pre-fill benefit forms and hold them pending EAD clearance. If EAD arrives within the payroll cutoff we can retro the benefits to start date; otherwise benefits will be effective on clearance date.
Tasha (Recruiter): I'll flag Legal for sign-off on contingent coverage retroactive wording. Marina, please keep receipts and any USCIS emails.
Leo (Payroll): Noted. I'll prepare a payroll note and provisional benefits packet to speed activation once docs clear.
Priya - People Ops: Action items:
- Marina: keep USCIS docs handy and notify if approval comes in.
- Tasha: ping Legal about contingent retro coverage language.
- Leo: prepare benefits packet and mark payroll for potential retro activation.
Marina V (New Hire): Thanks everyone ":)" - appreciate the help.
Priya - People Ops: We'll circle back once Legal replies.
